use_case: AI resume screening and candidate ranking (sort-only add-on to the ATS)
vendor_or_model: Third-party AI vendor integrated into SYS-01
source_evidence: EV-059 (council review); EV-061 (NYC bias audit and configuration); EV-087 (firm-data analysis); EV-046 (subscription)
data_categories: Resumes, application answers, work history, certifications, commute distance (no SSNs, Form I-9 data, consumer reports, or self-identification data)
human_in_the_loop: Score only sorts the list; recruiters review every applicant who meets the job order's minimum requirements; no automatic rejection
applicable_laws: Title VII 703(a), (b), (k) (42 U.S.C. 2000e-2); ADEA (29 U.S.C. 623(b)); ADA (42 U.S.C. 12112(b)(5)-(6)); NYC Local Law 144 (N56-R08); Illinois P.A. 103-0804; California 2 CCR 11008 et seq. and, from 2027-01-01, 11 CCR 7200 et seq.; Colorado SB26-189 from 2027-01-01
status: In production (all segments except ACQ-1, since 2024-09)
automated_employment_tool_status: NYC AEDT (bias audit 2026-02-09); covered ADMT in Colorado and ADMT in California from 2027-01-01
protected_characteristic_inputs: None as inputs; known proxies: employment gaps (sex), resume language (national origin), commute distance (race, through residence), years of experience (age)
bias_testing_status: NYC independent audit (NYC data) plus vendor data; first firm-data analysis 2026-08 flagged two disparities in Commercial Staffing (section 7.4)
monitoring: Quarterly firm-data selection-rate ratios by segment and job family; validity sample of 400 applicants a quarter; annual NYC audit

use_case: Generative drafting of job ads and candidate messages in the ATS
data_categories: Job order details; candidate names in messages
human_in_the_loop: Recruiter edits and approves every ad and message; ad checklist for prohibited preferences
applicable_laws: Title VII 704(b) (42 U.S.C. 2000e-3(b)); ADEA (29 U.S.C. 623(e)); FTC Act Section 5 (accurate pay and job claims)
automated_employment_tool_status: Not an automated employment decision tool
bias_testing_status: Quarterly sample of 100 ads for prohibited preferences

use_case: Fill-time and pay-rate prediction for job orders (Cloud B model)
vendor_or_model: In-house model on Cloud provider B AI services
data_categories: Job order history, pay rates, fill times, local market data (no worker identities)
consequential_decision_category: Employment (compensation) if used to set individual pay
human_in_the_loop: Account managers set the bill and pay rate; the model only suggests a market range for the job, not for a person
applicable_laws: Equal pay and pay transparency laws where jobs are located (counsel to map); FTC Act Section 5
automated_employment_tool_status: Not used for individual decisions; re-tier to High if used to set an individual's pay
protected_characteristic_inputs: None as inputs; location could proxy for demographics
bias_testing_status: Pay suggestion audit by job family and location (2026-06)
monitoring: Quarterly comparison of offered pay to suggested ranges by job family

use_case: Candidate chatbot on career sites (scheduling and FAQs)
vendor_or_model: Chatbot vendor using a hosted language model
data_categories: Candidate name, contact, interview times; free-text questions
human_in_the_loop: No decisions; hands off to a recruiter on request or after two failed answers; AI disclosure at the start
applicable_laws: ADA 12112(b)(5) (accommodation requests must reach a person); state chatbot disclosure laws where applicable (counsel to map)
automated_employment_tool_status: Not an automated employment decision tool after 2026-08 change

use_case: Bank-change fraud scoring (holds high-risk bank account changes for review)
business_owner: Senior Vice President, Payroll and Associate Services
source_evidence: EV-059 (council review); EV-044 (staff scoring since 2026-03); EV-046 (subscription)
data_categories: Bank change events, device, IP, account history
affects_individuals: Yes (a held change delays where pay goes)
human_in_the_loop: Analysts review every held change; associates are told how to confirm; no account is closed automatically
applicable_laws: State wage payment laws (timing); FCRA not implicated (no consumer report); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2)
status: In production (internal staff since 2026-03; associates from 2026-10, POAM-001)
automated_employment_tool_status: Not used in hiring or discipline
protected_characteristic_inputs: None as inputs; device and location signals may correlate with income or region
bias_testing_status: Hold rates by region and language reviewed monthly from 2026-10
monitoring: Hold rate, false positive rate, time to release

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant for recruiters and staff (approved tenant)
vendor_or_model: Cloud provider B AI service (enterprise tenant, no training on firm data)
data_categories: Internal documents; candidate data allowed only in approved recruiter workflows
human_in_the_loop: Users review all output; may not be used to rank or reject candidates (POL-05 4.3)
applicable_laws: Firm policy; state privacy laws for any personal data
automated_employment_tool_status: Not an automated employment decision tool (use for screening prohibited)
monitoring: Usage logs; blocked prompts with SSNs or I-9 data

use_case: Remote interview identity verification (document liveness and face match) for remote IT candidates
data_categories: Identity document images; selfie video; face templates
human_in_the_loop: Mismatches go to a trained reviewer; no candidate is rejected by the tool alone
applicable_laws: Biometric privacy laws where candidates reside (counsel review; Illinois candidates excluded from the pilot); Florida treatment of face templates computed from video is unsettled (counsel to confirm), so they are handled as biometric data; ADA 12112(b)(5); E-Verify and Form I-9 rules unchanged (8 CFR 274a.2(b)(1)(ii))
status: Pilot (Professional Staffing remote IT hires, since 2026-07)
council_review: Not reviewed (review due 2026-11-30; required before expansion)
automated_employment_tool_status: Identity proofing step, not a ranking tool
protected_characteristic_inputs: Face matching accuracy can vary by skin tone, age, and sex
bias_testing_status: Vendor demographic accuracy data requested; none on firm data

use_case: Invoice anomaly detection in the Workforce Management Platform (SL-1)
business_owner: Vice President, Product, Workforce Management Platform
data_categories: Invoice lines, rates, hours (supplier and worker identifiers)
human_in_the_loop: Flags only; client program teams review
applicable_laws: Client agreements; SOC 2 Processing Integrity commitments (P09)

use_case: Associate redeployment ranking (who is offered the next assignment) in the Commercial Staffing branch app
vendor_or_model: Branch scheduling vendor feature (enabled by a 2026-05 release)
data_categories: Assignment history, attendance, client feedback, distance, skills
human_in_the_loop: Branch staff see a ranked list; they choose who to call; no automatic offers
applicable_laws: Title VII 703(a), (b), (k) (42 U.S.C. 2000e-2); ADEA (29 U.S.C. 623(b)); ADA (42 U.S.C. 12112(b)(5)-(6)); Illinois P.A. 103-0804; California 2 CCR 11008 et seq.; Colorado SB26-189 and California 11 CCR 7200 et seq. from 2027-01-01
council_review: Not reviewed (entered through a vendor release before the intake block; review due 2026-11-30)
automated_employment_tool_status: Likely a covered ADMT for Colorado and ADMT for California from 2027-01-01 (counsel to confirm)
protected_characteristic_inputs: Attendance and client feedback can carry disability and bias effects; distance can proxy for residence
monitoring: Planned: offer-rate ratios by group each quarter

use_case: Timesheet anomaly detection (possible buddy punching or padded hours)
data_categories: Clock-in times, GPS location at clock-in, device
human_in_the_loop: Flags go to branch managers; no pay is withheld and no discipline happens without a human investigation
applicable_laws: State wage payment laws; geolocation is personal information under Fla. Stat. 501.171 (worked example)
automated_employment_tool_status: Not used in hiring; could become a covered tool if used for discipline
protected_characteristic_inputs: Location patterns may correlate with neighborhood
monitoring: Flag rate by branch; outcome of investigations

data_categories: Security alerts and logs (may include workforce identifiers)
